title: Transformer-Based Trajectory Prescription for sEMG-Optimizing Robot-Mediated Rehabilitation
abstract: arXiv:2611.08295v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot-mediated rehabilitation has the potential to deliver high-intensity, individualized therapy, but existing systems (which have not consistently improved outcomes) typically prescribe kinematic trajectories rather than explicitly targeting the neuromotor activations thought to support recovery. To address this gap, and ultimately enable activation-optimizing rehabilitation robot behavior, we present a personalizable transformer-based model mapping individuals' muscle activations (as measured via surface electromyography) to prescribed contact force trajectories when interacting with an end-effector rehabilitation robot. translated_title: 基于Transformer的面向sEMG优化的机器人介导康复轨迹处方方法
translated_abstract: 机器人介导的康复具有提供高强度、个性化治疗的潜力，但现有系统（并未持续改善治疗效果）通常仅规定运动学轨迹，而非明确针对被认为能够支持恢复的神经运动激活。为填补这一空白，并最终实现以激活优化为目标的康复机器人行为，我们提出了一个可个性化的基于Transformer的模型，将个体的肌肉激活（通过表面肌电图测量）映射到与末端执行器康复机器人交互时规定的接触力轨迹。该模型使用采用旋转位置编码的Transformer编码器-解码器来生成与轨迹相关且用户特定的神经运动因素的潜在表示，并通过流匹配来增强轨迹预测，从而产生偏向于目标激活模式的合理处方分布。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个可个性化的Transformer模型，利用旋转位置编码和流匹配，将康复机器人训练中用户的表面肌电肌肉激活映射为接触力轨迹处方，从而实现以神经运动激活优化为目标的机器人介导康复。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a personalizable transformer-based model using rotary positional embeddings and flow matching to map individuals' sEMG-measured muscle activations to prescribed contact force trajectories, enabling neuromotor activation-optimizing robot-mediated rehabilitation.
